outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar plot showing mean ± SD of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, and individual data points (colored dots) for each biological replicate are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is a schematic diagram, not a data plot.
Panel C shows representative MRI images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E histology images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope images with annotated regions, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows an H&E image and RNAscope images with annotations, not a plot of averaged data.
